findings.title: Test omits cross-plane label overlap case
findings.why_it_matters: The new label-pair loop deliberately skips labels on different planes, but the regression exercises only two labels on the same plane. A future change that drops or reverses the plane guard would emit false LABEL_OVERLAP diagnostics for separate BPMN diagrams without this test failing.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a regression with geometrically overlapping labels assigned to different plane IDs and assert that no LABEL_OVERLAP diagnostic is emitted for their owner IDs.
evidence: tests/helpers/bpmnGeometry.ts adds `if (left.planeId !== right.planeId || !finiteBounds(right.bounds)) continue;` for label-label pairs.
The new test at tests/helpers/bpmnGeometry.test.ts:133 creates both labels in the simple-process fixture's single plane and asserts only the collision path.

testing_gaps: No direct regression covers the newly introduced label-pair skip when the two labels belong to different BPMN planes.
